user.title: Schluter DITRA-HEAT
user.description: Sign in with the account you use at ditra-heat-e-wifi.schluter.com. The password is stored in Home Assistant, not in any file you edit.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved password for {email} no longer works. Enter the current one.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up

init.title: Connection
init.description: Cloud only needs nothing. Relay and Local also run a gateway on this Home Assistant host that the thermostats connect to directly, which needs a DNS record on your network pointing na-thermos.ojelectronics.com at this host (see the README). Relay keeps the Schluter app working; Local does not.

options.relay: Cloud + local gateway, relayed to Schluter (recommended)
options.local: Local gateway only (the Schluter app shows offline)
